title: UK government ‘irresponsible’ for not publishing emergency drought plans

paragraphs.en: The UK government has been accused of a lack of transparency and of acting irresponsibly for refusing to publish the emergency drought plans that are produced by water companies.
paragraphs.zh: 英国政府被指缺乏透明度、行事不负责任，因为它拒绝公布水务公司编制的应急干旱计划。

paragraphs.en: Water firms are required to publish statutory drought plans every five years to detail the actions needed to ensure public water supply is maintained and the environment is protected during drought.
paragraphs.zh: 水务公司每五年须依法公布一次干旱计划，详细说明在干旱期间为保障公共供水、保护环境所需采取的行动。

paragraphs.en: Water levels at five key reservoirs in England and Wales are now “exceptionally low” and three-quarters of England and the whole of Wales are in drought.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，英格兰和威尔士五个主要水库的水位“异常偏低”，英格兰四分之三的地区和整个威尔士都处于干旱之中。

paragraphs.en: The 2027-32 drought plans, which are under consultation, detail what will happen in different scenarios, with the most extreme actions ranging from standpipes in the street to rota cuts, where water is limited to a few hours each day.
paragraphs.zh: 正在征求意见的2027—2032年干旱计划详细说明了不同情景下将发生的情况，其中最为极端的措施包括在街头设置临街供水管，以及实施轮换停水，即每天限水数小时。

paragraphs.en: Alongside these publicly available plans, water companies are required to produce separate emergency drought plans.
paragraphs.zh: 除了这些可公开获取的计划之外，水务公司还被要求编制单独的应急干旱计划。

paragraphs.en: A water industry source said these plans were not published to avoid alarming the public. The government said the plans were not published for security reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 一位水务行业消息人士表示，这些计划之所以不公布，是为了避免引起公众恐慌。而政府表示，这些计划是出于安全原因而不予公布。

paragraphs.en: Alastair Chisholm, the water, policy, regulation and governance lead at the consultancy firm Arup, said that in the “new normal” of the climate crisis causing droughts to become more frequent and more extreme, there would probably be situations where “some quite difficult decisions need to be taken with some quite significant imposition’s on people’s lifestyles”.
paragraphs.zh: 咨询公司奥雅纳（Arup）的水务、政策、监管和治理负责人阿拉斯泰尔·奇泽姆表示，在气候危机使干旱变得更加频繁、更加极端的“新常态”下，很可能会出现“需要做出一些相当艰难的决定，对人们的生活方式造成相当大的影响”的情况。

paragraphs.en: He pointed to Day Zero in Cape Town, South Africa, in 2018, when millions of households faced drastic water shortages after the worst drought to hit the city in almost a century.
paragraphs.zh: 他提到了2018年南非开普敦的“归零日”（Day Zero），当时在近一个世纪以来最严重干旱的打击下，数百万家庭面临严重的水荒。
